fields.title: Privacy Policy
fields.content:
Privacy Policy

Last updated: January 2025

1. Information We Collect

We collect information you provide directly, such as your name, email address, phone number, and shipping address when you place an order or create an account.

2. How We Use Your Information

  • To process and fulfill your orders
  • To communicate about your order status
  • To improve our services and website
  • To send promotional offers (with your consent)

3. Data Security

We implement industry-standard security measures to protect your personal information. Your payment information is encrypted and never stored on our servers.

4. Contact Us

For privacy-related queries, contact our Data Protection Officer at privacy@yourstore.com

fields.title: Refund Policy
fields.content:
Refund & Return Policy

7-Day Return Policy

We offer a 7-day return window from the date of delivery. Items must be unused, in original packaging, and accompanied by the original receipt.

How to Initiate a Return

  1. Contact our support team within 7 days of delivery
  2. Provide your order number and reason for return
  3. Our team will arrange a pickup or guide you on drop-off
  4. Refund is processed within 5-7 business days of receiving the item

Non-Returnable Items

  • Opened software or digital products
  • Perishable goods
  • Items marked as "Final Sale"
  • Undergarments for hygiene reasons

Refund Methods

Refunds are processed to the original payment method. Cash on Delivery orders are refunded via bank transfer.

fields.title: FAQ
fields.content:

How long does delivery take?
Standard delivery takes 3-5 business days. Express delivery is available in 1-2 days for major cities.

Do you deliver nationwide?
Yes, we deliver to all major cities and towns across Pakistan.

How do I track my order?
Once your order is dispatched, you will receive an SMS/email with a tracking link.

≡ƒÆ│ Payments

What payment methods do you accept?
We accept Cash on Delivery (COD) and bank transfers. Online card payments coming soon!

Is Cash on Delivery available everywhere?
COD is available in most cities. You'll see COD availability at checkout for your area.

≡ƒöä Returns & Refunds

How do I return a product?
Contact us within 7 days of receiving your order. See our full Return Policy for details.

When will I receive my refund?
Refunds are processed within 5-7 business days after we receive the returned item.
